overview_description.description:
Peak is a decision intelligence company that provides a platform to offer data analysis services. The company helps commercial decision-making for the companies with its AI software. Peak’s pioneering Decision Intelligence software embeds AI across sales, marketing, planning, and supply chains to accelerate revenues and profits. Headquartered in Manchester (UK), Peak’s customer base includes PrettyLittleThing, AO, KFC, PepsiCo, Marshalls, and Speedy Hire.

Peak’s customers have seen transformational results, including a 5% increase in total company revenues, a doubling of return on advertising spend, a 12% reduction in inventory holdings, and a 5% reduction in supply chain costs.

Peak has been named a Gartner ‘Cool Vendor’ for AI in retail and was also named in The Sunday Times 100 Best Small Companies to Work For 2020 with the Best Companies 3-star accreditation, which recognizes extraordinary levels of employee engagement. Peak is an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Advanced Technology Partner and is ISO 27001 accredited.

about_short_description.short_description: Peak is a decision intelligence company that provides a platform to offer data analysis services.

product.name: Peak AI Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for connecting data, building and configuring AI models, orchestrating workflows, and deploying AI outputs through APIs and applications.

product.name: Inventory AI
product.description: An AI product for optimizing inventory decisions, including demand forecasting, stock levels, replenishment, rebuys, production planning, and supply chain scenarios.

product.name: Pricing AI
product.description: An AI product that recommends prices and optimizes markdowns, promotions, list prices, and quotes to balance demand, revenue, conversion, and profitability.

product.name: Agentic Commercial Pricing
product.description: An agentic AI solution that manages commercial pricing and quote-to-order workflows by predicting demand, recommending prices, and executing approved pricing actions.

product.name: Agentic Merchandising
product.description: An agentic AI solution that automates retail merchandising decisions across demand forecasting, buying, inventory allocation, replenishment, promotions, and markdowns.

product.name: Agentic Inventory Management
product.description: An agentic AI solution for automating inventory decisions across purchasing, production, and fulfillment while maintaining business controls and oversight.
